reviewStatus.not_reviewed: Nobody has looked at this record. It is the state every deposit lands in, and it is a statement about TCKDB's attention, not about the science: an unreviewed record can be perfectly good.
reviewStatus.under_review: A curator has this record open. It is entered deliberately by a curator, never by depositing, which is the whole difference from not_reviewed. For example: A freshly deposited record is not_reviewed. It becomes under_review only when a curator opens it, so a list of under_review records is a list of records someone is working on.
reviewStatus.approved: A curator reviewed the record and accepts it. This is the floor the curated read profile draws at for lists, searches, browses, selects and exports: they return approved records and nothing below them. A detail page can still serve a record below the floor, with its review badge.
reviewStatus.rejected: A curator reviewed the record and does not accept it. Absent from results unless the request asks for it with include_rejected=true.
reviewStatus.deprecated: The record is not to be used — superseded by a better one, or withdrawn. It is kept rather than deleted so an existing citation still resolves. Absent from results unless the request asks with include_deprecated=true.

trustStatus.well_supported: Evidence completeness of 0.90 or better and every check the rubric marks required passed. The required-checks gate is separate from the ratio: a record cannot reach this badge on volume of evidence alone.
trustStatus.unsupported: Evidence completeness below 0.25. Incomplete, which is not the same as wrong — this is the expected badge for an old record deposited before TCKDB asked for much.
trustStatus.hard_failed: A discrete structural failure was found, and the badge is set by that finding rather than by the ratio. Always read trust.evidence.hard_fail_reason beside it: the reason says whether the record contradicts itself, or whether TCKDB cannot produce the evidence it rests on.

checkOutcome.passed: The check's condition held. Positive evidence, and it counts.
checkOutcome.missing: The check applied and did not pass. It counts against the record: it is inside the denominator and outside the numerator of the completeness ratio.
checkOutcome.warning: The check applied, the underlying signal is tri-state, and the result is informational. Warning-kind checks carry zero weight, so this never moves the completeness ratio.
checkOutcome.not_applicable: The question could not be asked of this record, so the check is excluded from both the numerator and the denominator — it neither helps nor hurts. For example: When geometry_validation_present_for_source_calculations is missing, there is no validation verdict to inspect, so geometry_validation_not_failed_for_source_calculations is not_applicable: "did it fail?" has no answer. Rendering that as false would count the same absence twice.

hardFailReason.calculation_missing: The calculation this verdict is about could not be loaded at all.
hardFailReason.calculation_rejected: The calculation's quality is rejected — a curator marked it unusable.
hardFailReason.kinetics_missing: The kinetics record could not be loaded.
hardFailReason.statmech_missing: The statistical-mechanics record could not be loaded.
hardFailReason.thermo_missing: The thermochemistry record could not be loaded.
hardFailReason.transport_missing: The transport record could not be loaded.
hardFailReason.species_entry_missing: The record does not point at the species entry it is supposed to describe, so there is nothing to attribute it to.
hardFailReason.no_thermo_representation_present: A thermochemistry record carrying no thermochemistry: no NASA polynomial, no Wilhoit, no scalar values, no points. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.no_transport_property_present: A transport record carrying no transport property at all. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.invalid_lj_pair: The Lennard-Jones parameters are not a usable pair. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.invalid_temperature_range: The record's validity range is definitionally impossible: a non-positive temperature, or a minimum above the maximum. Note that a single-temperature range (tmin == tmax) is legal and does not fire this, and there is no upper bound — shock-tube and plasma chemistry are not structurally broken.
hardFailReason.invalid_external_symmetry: The external symmetry number is below 1. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.invalid_torsion_dimension: A hindered-rotor torsion declares a dimension below 1. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.geometry_validation_failed: Not issued by any current rubric; kept so stored reviews made before rubric versioning (version 0) still parse. Current rubrics report a failed automated geometry comparison as a warning on the geometry check.
hardFailReason.artifact_integrity_failed: The stored bytes behind one of this calculation's artifacts do not match their digest, or are gone. This one is a statement about TCKDB's custody of the evidence, not about the depositor's science: the record may be perfectly good and we cannot show you what it rests on. It reflects the latest observation per artifact, so a restored object clears it.
hardFailReason.missing_required_identity: The kinetics record does not identify a complete reaction — no reaction entry, or a side with no participants on it.
hardFailReason.source_calculation_hard_failed_for_requi: A calculation this record depends on for a role it cannot do without — a reactant or product energy, the TS energy, the frequencies — is itself hard-failed. The failure is inherited, so read that calculation's own reason.
hardFailReason.transition_state_entry_missing: The transition-state entry could not be loaded.
hardFailReason.transition_state_parent_missing: The entry does not point at the transition state it is an entry for.
hardFailReason.reaction_entry_missing: The parent transition state names no reaction entry, so the TS belongs to no reaction.
hardFailReason.ts_entry_status_rejected: The transition-state entry's own status is rejected.
hardFailReason.multiplicity_invalid: The spin multiplicity is below 1. A backstop — the upload path refuses this.
hardFailReason.all_source_calculations_hard_failed: Every calculation supporting this transition-state entry is itself hard-failed, so nothing is left to support it.
hardFailReason.geometry_validation_failed_for_source_ca: Not issued by any current rubric; kept so stored reviews made before rubric versioning (version 0) still parse. Current rubrics report a supporting calculation that failed the automated geometry comparison as a warning on the geometry check.
hardFailReason.frequency_source_has_zero_imaginary_mode: Not issued by any current rubric; kept so stored reviews made before rubric versioning (version 0) still parse. Current rubrics issue no frequency verdict; the same fact is the warning no_frequency_result_lacks_an_imaginary_mode, and the scoped judgement (does a usable result on the evaluated geometry contradict the saddle claim) is the structure assessment's.
hardFailReason.frequency_source_reaction_coordinate_not: Not issued by any current rubric; kept so stored reviews made before rubric versioning (version 0) still parse. Current rubrics issue no frequency verdict; a missing designation is the missing check reaction_coordinate_designated_for_ts, and the structure assessment reports it as the unresolved reaction_coordinate_not_established.

reproducibilityGrade.insufficient: The record does not even describe what was done well enough to audit.
reproducibilityGrade.described: What the record is and the scientific context around it are recorded. The ceiling for every non-calculation record.
reproducibilityGrade.auditable: The preserved evidence can be inspected: the output bytes are there and were read back through the artifact path.
reproducibilityGrade.rerunnable: The deposit is complete enough to attempt a rerun — preserved inputs, an execution-parameter snapshot, the upstream dependency snapshot, and no warnings about artifact bytes TCKDB could not read. It is not a claim that a rerun would reproduce the numbers.
